name: ork
description: AI development toolkit: 105 skills, 36 agents, 218 hooks for full-stack work. The hooks run on every session, prompt, and tool call to enforce quality gates (they are the product, not telemetry) and write metrics to a local file. No network calls and no data leaves your machine unless you explicitly set ORCHESTKIT_HOOK_URL or ORK_HQ_TELEMETRY_URL; both are unset by default. See README 'What OrchestKit observes'.
